ResourceHeader.ResourceName: Hinode SOT-FG Level 0 Shutterless Full-Stokes FITS Data (FGSIQUV)

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial metadata creation and publication. SY

ResourceHeader.Description: The Hinode Solar Optical Telescope Filtergraph (SOT-FG) Level 0 FGSIQUV FITS data product contains uncalibrated Stokes I, Q, U, and V image arrays acquired in the shutterless full-Stokes observing mode. The product is identified by DataCode FGSIQUV and OBS_TYPE='FG shutterless Stokes', distinguishing it from the shuttered FGIQUV product. Each inspected FITS Primary HDU contains a three-dimensional array with four image planes for Stokes I, Q, U, and V. Shutterless readout enables rapid polarimetric imaging over a restricted field of view; the image dimensions and angular pixel scales depend on observing settings. The FITS headers identify the product with GEN_ID=33 and generally report FGMODE='shutterless'. The observing passband and its wavelength offset are recorded by the FITS keywords WAVE and WAVEOFF. The Level 0 images precede ground-based scientific calibration.

Parameter.Name: Shutterless Stokes I, Q, U, and V Images
Parameter.Description: Three-dimensional Level 0 SOT-FG full-Stokes image data stored in the FITS Primary HDU. The first two array dimensions represent spatial image coordinates, and the third dimension contains four image planes corresponding to Stokes I, Q, U, and V. The shutterless observing mode ordinarily uses a restricted field of view. Observations are made at selected discrete passbands rather than over a continuous wavelength range; the FITS keywords WAVE and WAVEOFF indicate the recorded passband and offset. The images have not undergone ground-based scientific calibration.
